headline: 16 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi factory fire
summary: A devastating blaze at a sofa factory in Riyadh's Musa Industrial Area claimed the lives of 16 Bangladeshi nationals.
details: At least 16 Bangladeshi nationals were killed in a devastating fire at a sofa factory in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, according to the Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Ministry.
The blaze broke out around 2:00 pm yesterday in the Musa Industrial Area under the Al-Shifa police station. All 16 victims died on the spot.
The Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh has expressed deep sorrow over the incident and is working closely with Saudi authorities to identify the victims.
Expatriates’ Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury previously reported that seven of the victims were from Naogaon’s Atrai upazila.
Local fire services were still conducting rescue operations as of early today (Bangladesh time).
caption:
16 Bangladeshi workers killed on the spot in a devastating sofa factory fire in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

At least 16 Bangladeshi nationals were killed in a devastating fire at a sofa factory in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, according to the Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Ministry.

The blaze broke out around 2:00 pm yesterday in the Musa Industrial Area under the Al-Shifa police station. All 16 victims died on the spot.

The Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh has expressed deep sorrow over the incident and is working closely with Saudi authorities to identify the victims.

Expatriates’ Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury previously reported that seven of the victims were from Naogaon’s Atrai upazila.

Local fire services were still conducting rescue operations as of early today (Bangladesh time).

headline: BNP's Mirza Fakhrul likely to be presidential nominee
summary: The party may formally announce him as its candidate on Wednesday or Thursday, potentially triggering a major cabinet reshuffle.
details: BNP Secretary General and LGRD Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is likely to be the party's nominee for president, according to multiple party sources.
Fakhrul has already signed the consent form for the nomination. The party is expected to formally announce him as its candidate on Wednesday or Thursday.
If elected, Fakhrul's departure from the cabinet and the BNP secretary general's post would lead to significant leadership changes. Ruhul Kabir Rizvi is expected to serve as acting secretary general.
Under a proposed arrangement, Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed may take over the Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development and Cooperatives.
Additionally, Water Resources Minister Md Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee may be appointed as the new home minister, though these changes have not yet been formally approved.
Mirza Fakhrul has been a central figure in the BNP's organizational and political decision-making for over a decade, serving as secretary general since 2016.
The presidential election will take place on August 20, with nomination papers to be submitted by August 13.
caption:
A major leadership shake-up is coming to the BNP. Mirza Fakhrul is set to become the party's presidential nominee.

BNP Secretary General and LGRD Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is likely to be the party's nominee for president, according to multiple party sources.

Fakhrul has already signed the consent form for the nomination. The party is expected to formally announce him as its candidate on Wednesday or Thursday.

If elected, Fakhrul's departure from the cabinet and the BNP secretary general's post would lead to significant leadership changes. Ruhul Kabir Rizvi is expected to serve as acting secretary general.

Under a proposed arrangement, Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed may take over the Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development and Cooperatives.

Additionally, Water Resources Minister Md Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee may be appointed as the new home minister, though these changes have not yet been formally approved.

Mirza Fakhrul has been a central figure in the BNP's organizational and political decision-making for over a decade, serving as secretary general since 2016.

The presidential election will take place on August 20, with nomination papers to be submitted by August 13.
